qwen_trigger: Conservative screening: if none of the three small candidates has clean raw CER <=10% AND all listed critical_strings present, test Qwen0.6B. The listed strings include negation, date/count and names; all are included.
not_semantic_verdict: Literal mismatches such as 2022年 versus 二零二二年 trigger review but are not automatically semantic errors. Report raw CER and human-inspected numeric/negation/name errors separately; do not silently normalize them away.
production_acceptance: Not established by 24 public clean utterances. No household/microphone/domain audio tested.
